Results.ReviewText: I got my Weber Spirit II from Home Depot and have so far grilled hot dogs, bratwurst, chicken kebabs, hamburgers, salmon, pork chops, asparagus, onions, mushrooms, and peppers.  The grill is pretty basic for a 500 dollar grill but all the features it comes with are flawless and the 10 year warranty is unbeatable. I look forward to getting all 10 years and more out of it. The propane meter is awesome, the double side grill irons are great, and it really does light every time as long as it's cleaned every so often. I looked at quite a few grills before settling on this one and I'm so glad I did. Grilling has been a breeze since upgrading to the Spirit II from the kettle I used to have.
Results.Title: Fantastic basic gas grill for the long haul

Results.ReviewText:
I have been a Weber user for over 40+ years and this is the absolute worst purchase ive ever made! Ive had the grill for about a month and i still cant use it. The box was intact and looked good, but everything inside was a disaster. The leg was bent and twisted. The igniter button was broken. One of the manifold knob shafts were bent to a 45 degree angle and the warming rack does not fit.

Weber has been working with me to replace damaged parts. Ive been told twice now that the manifold will ship on a date. Still hasnt shipped. The igniter switch and leg was delivered and have been installed. The replacement warming rack was delivered yesterday and this one doesn't fit either. Now im wondering if i have the wrong bottom tub for the grill...
Results.Title: Expensive box of broken parts!

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
